WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT MIN(d_date_sk) AS min_date_sk,
           MAX(d_date_sk) AS max_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2000
),
customer_total_return AS (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca.ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM (
        SELECT
            wr_returning_customer_sk,
            wr_returning_addr_sk,
            wr_return_amt
        FROM web_returns
        WHERE wr_returned_date_sk BETWEEN (SELECT min_date_sk FROM date_range)
                                      AND (SELECT max_date_sk FROM date_range)
    ) AS wr
    JOIN customer_address AS ca ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, ca.ca_state
),
customer_total_return_avg AS (
    SELECT
        ctr_customer_sk,
        ctr_state,
        ctr_total_return,
        AVG(ctr_total_return) OVER (PARTITION BY ctr_state) * 1.2 AS ctr_state_avg
    FROM customer_total_return
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr.ctr_total_return
FROM (SELECT ca_address_sk FROM customer_address WHERE ca_state = 'AR') AS ca
JOIN customer c ON ca.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
JOIN customer_total_return_avg ctr ON ctr.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE ctr.ctr_state IS NOT NULL
  AND ctr.ctr_total_return > ctr.ctr_state_avg
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
